sloka: विज्ञाय परम प्रीता मुनयो हर्षम् आगमन् ।अर्घ्यम् पाद्यम् तथा आतिथ्यम् निवेद्य कुशिकात्मजे ॥१-२३-१९॥
transliteration: vijñāya parama prītā munayo harṣam āgaman ।arghyam pādyam tathā ātithyam nivedya kuśikātmaje ॥1-23-19॥

translations.english: After extending hospitality to the son of Kusika (Viswamitra) with respectful offerings, and water for washing feet they played the host to Rama and Lakshmana.
